channel.title: Touchline Sport
channel.description: Independent football journalism covering Irish football, recruitment, club strategy, ownership, academies and tactical analysis.

item.title: David Alaba Joins Udinese Until 2027 After Real Madrid Exit
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The four-time Champions League winner insists he is not winding down as Udinese add vast experience to Kosta Runjaic’s defence.

item.title: Hibs Appoint Marink Reedijk After Unbeaten Belgian Title Season
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The 35-year-old arrives at Easter Road after winning 28 of 32 league games with SK Beveren without losing once.

item.title: Why Andy Burnham Wants Football’s 41-Year Alcohol Ban Reviewed
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: From WSL trials to policing concerns and club revenue, the case for changing one of English football’s longest-standing matchday rules is back on the table.

item.title: Christian Eriksen Leaves Wolfsburg After Contract Terminated Early
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Denmark international will continue his rehabilitation closer to his family after bringing his eventful spell in Germany to an early end.

item.title: Enzo Le Fée Signs New Sunderland Contract Until 2031
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The French midfielder arrived for a Championship promotion push. Twenty months later, he is scoring European winners and staying until 2031.

item.title: Valencia Appoint Javier Aguirre After Early-Season Collapse
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The experienced Mexican takes over with Valencia 19th as Braulio Vázquez returns to rebuild the club’s football operation.

item.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Considered Portugal Retirement After World Cup
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The 41-year-old thought about stopping this summer but has decided to continue, with career goal number 1,000 now 21 away.

item.title: Harry Kane Considers MLS and NFL Double Act for Later Career
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Bayern Munich striker says becoming an NFL kicker is something he wants to seriously explore, potentially while finishing his football career in Major League Soccer.

item.title: Sligo Rovers Members Vote on Private Investment Restructure
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The proposal could open the football operation to outside money while keeping the Showgrounds and majority control with members.

item.title: Do National Football Styles Still Exist?
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Brazil had joga bonito, Italy had catenaccio and the Netherlands had Total Football. So what happened to football’s great national styles?

item.title: Manchester United Post Record £677.6m Revenue Despite £43m Loss
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: United made more money than ever without European football, while lower costs, higher finance charges and £63.5m of stadium land shaped the year.

item.title: Cherries Picking: How Bournemouth Keep Finding Football’s Best Value
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Bournemouth have gone from Steve Cook and a 17-point deduction to developing players for Real Madrid, Liverpool and PSG. It has been some upgrade.

item.title: Shamrock Rovers Teen Jayden Marshall Signs Three-Year Como Deal
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The 16-year-old centre-back has joined the Serie A club after a rapid rise through Shamrock Rovers and the Republic of Ireland underage setup.

item.title: Mikel Arteta Agrees New Arsenal Contract After Premier League Title
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Arsenal manager has agreed improved terms after ending a 22-year title wait and taking the club back to a Champions League final.

item.title: Borussia Mönchengladbach Appoint Alexander Blessin Until 2028
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The former St Pauli coach takes over with Gladbach bottom of the Bundesliga after the worst start in the club’s history.

item.title: Stephen Bradley Emerges as Leading Candidate for Hibernian Job
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Shamrock Rovers boss is firmly in the running to replace David Gray, with his record developing young players helping bring him onto Hibs’ radar.

item.title: German FA President Calls Infantino FIFA Reform Offer a ‘Ploy’
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Bernd Neuendorf says FIFA needs reform after the collapse of its private-investment plan, but Gianni Infantino should not be leading it.

item.title: Kerry County Council Seeks FAI-IFA Talks on All-Ireland Team
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: More than a century after Irish football split in two, Kerry councillors want the FAI and IFA discussing whether it still has to stay that way.

item.title: Bohemians to Save Up to €400k by Staying at Dalymount Until May 2027
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Four extra months in Phibsborough will protect matchday income before Bohs begin a complicated spell across several temporary grounds.

item.title: Daniel Levy’s $1bn Tottenham Stake Deal Stalls Over Payment
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The former Spurs chairman is still waiting to complete his ENIC exit while the Lewis family continue putting fresh money into Tottenham.

item.title: Wrexham Exchange Contracts to Buy Historic Turf Pub
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The deal would bring Wrexham AFC, the Racecourse Ground and the pub where the club was founded under common ownership.

item.title: 160+ Irish Athletes Urge Ireland Players to Boycott Israel Games
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The Stop The Game campaign has appealed directly to Heimir Hallgrímsson’s squad with Ireland’s first meeting with Israel six days away.

item.title: Brian Sørensen Confirmed as Republic of Ireland WNT Assistant
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: The former Everton manager joins Carla Ward before the World Cup play-offs, with Ireland four matches away from Brazil 2027.

item.title: Spain Extend Luis de la Fuente Contract Until 2032
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Spain have handed their World Cup-winning coach another six years after a relationship with the national-team system stretching back to 2013.

item.title: Home Farm DCU: Could One of Irish Football’s Great Names Be Back?
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Home Farm DCU have started fast in the National League. Could the League of Ireland be next?

item.title: Ireland Midfield Injuries Could Open Door for Late LOI Call-Up
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Bosun Lawal, Jamie McGrath and Harvey Vale are all fitness concerns before Kosovo, with Heimir Hallgrímsson already familiar with several domestic options.

item.title: Legia Warsaw Owner Nears Reported €50m Sale of 40% Stake
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: An American investor could take a major minority stake in Legia, with financial stability reportedly ahead of any spending spree.

item.title: Hallgrímsson Questions UEFA as Ireland Strips Back Israel Fixtures
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Ireland’s manager has questioned why Russia remains suspended as the FAI and RTÉ remove much of the usual machinery around the Israel games.

item.title: Barcelona Members Approve €510m as Camp Nou Bill Keeps Growing
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Barça will borrow another €300m for Spotify Camp Nou and raise €210m against future La Liga and UEFA media income.

item.title: Court Blocks Corinthians Statute Vote Before 2026 Election
item.dc:creator: James Callan
item.description: Members were due to vote on electoral rules and expanded voting rights before the courts intervened for a fourth time.
